Long, straight, platinum white hair with long bangs framing the face. Wide, staring, pale gray eyes with a cold, detached expression. Apparent age is a mid-adolescent with a stoic face. Slender, delicate build. A dark charcoal gray oversized sweater dress with a white sailor collar and a black ribbon. Signature details include a black beret and massive, dark gray metallic submarine rigging floating behind.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
